meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的目标拆成极小的步骤,按工作手册逐步执行;每完成一步就记录可验证的证据,并实时更新进度清单。涉及代码时,它会派子代理去写代码并核查结果,最终按证据判断完成。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”、“ulw”等关键词,或要求做有证据支撑的长期交付时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw 流程帮我推进这个项目,先拆解再执行。
say.note: Claude 会先读工作流程并按步骤来。

say.text: 启动 ulw-loop,把目标分解并逐步记录证据。
say.note: 会创建目标状态并更新计划。

say.text: 我要做一次有证据支撑的长期交付,用 ulw-loop 管理。
say.note: Claude 会按证据标准要求逐项验证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude breaks your goal into very small steps, follows a manual workflow, records observable evidence for each step, and updates the plan in real time. For code tasks, it delegates writing to subagents and verifies results before concluding completion.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like 'ulw-loop' or 'ulw', or ask for evidence-led long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use the ulw workflow for this project: decompose first, then execute.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow and follows it.

say_en.text: Start ulw-loop, break the goal into steps and record evidence.
say_en.note: It creates goal state and updates the plan.

say_en.text: I need an evidence-bound long-term delivery managed by ulw-loop.
say_en.note: Claude validates each step against evidence.
